sentences.text: The Applicant and Respondent No.2 are present in the  Court.
It is submitted that they have resolved their dispute.
It is  stated by them they are going to perform marriage.
Notice of  marriage has been issued.
4. Respondent No.2 has no objection for quashing the FIR.
She is represented by Advocate.
She has filed an affidavit of  consent for quashing the FIR along with it notice of intended  marriage is annexed.
The complainant has tendered an affidavit to  the concerned police station indicating that the matter has been  settled and she has no grievance against the Petitioner.
We have  perused the FIR which indicates that the accused and the  complainant were acquainted with each other.
There was promise  of marriage.
There was physical relation between each other which  is apparently of consensual in nature.
5. Considering the factual matrix of the matter, the  impugned FIR can be quashed.

(N. R. BORKAR, J.) (PRAKASH D. NAIK, J.)
